WITH locked_parents AS (
      SELECT j.name, j.id
      FROM jobs.job_common j
      WHERE j.blocking
        AND j.state = 'completed'
        AND j.name = ANY($1::text[])
      ORDER BY j.name, j.id

    ),
    decremented AS (
      SELECT d.child_name, d.child_id, COUNT(*)::int AS n
      FROM jobs.job_dependency d
      JOIN locked_parents p ON d.parent_name = p.name
        AND d.parent_id = p.id
      GROUP BY d.child_name, d.child_id
    ),
    locked_children AS (
      SELECT j.name, j.id, d.n
      FROM jobs.job j
      JOIN decremented d ON d.child_name = j.name
        AND d.child_id = j.id
      WHERE j.blocked
      ORDER BY j.name, j.id
      FOR UPDATE OF j
    ),
    unblocked AS (
      UPDATE jobs.job j
      SET pending_dependencies = GREATEST(j.pending_dependencies - lc.n, 0),
          blocked = GREATEST(j.pending_dependencies - lc.n, 0) > 0,
          start_after = CASE WHEN GREATEST(j.pending_dependencies - lc.n, 0) = 0
            THEN GREATEST(j.start_after, jobs.job_now())
            ELSE j.start_after END
      FROM locked_children lc
      WHERE j.name = lc.name
        AND j.id = lc.id
      RETURNING 1
    ),
    cleared AS (
      UPDATE jobs.job_common j
      SET blocking = false

    FROM jobs.job_common

WITH o AS (SELECT $1::text::jsonb AS data),
    target AS (
      SELECT job.id
      FROM jobs.job_common job, o
      WHERE job.name = 'comments.mention'
        AND job.state < 'active'
        AND job.singleton_key = o.data->>'singletonKey'
      ORDER BY job.created_on DESC LIMIT 1
    ),
    upd AS (
      UPDATE jobs.job_common job
      SET data = CASE WHEN (o.data -> 'data') IS NOT NULL THEN o.data->'data' ELSE job.data END,
          priority = COALESCE((o.data->>'priority')::int, job.priority),
          start_after = 
        CASE WHEN (o.data -> 'startAfter') IS NOT NULL
          THEN CASE WHEN (right(o.data->>'startAfter', 1) = 'Z' OR o.data->>'startAfter' ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}')
                 THEN (o.data->>'startAfter')::timestamptz
                 ELSE jobs.job_now() + CAST(o.data->>'startAfter' AS interval) END
          ELSE job.start_after END,
          keep_until = CASE
            WHEN (o.data -> 'retentionSeconds') IS NOT NULL
              THEN (
        CASE WHEN (o.data -> 'startAfter') IS NOT NULL
          THEN CASE WHEN (right(o.data->>'startAfter', 1) = 'Z' OR o.data->>'startAfter' ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}')
                 THEN (o.data->>'startAfter')::timestamptz
                 ELSE jobs.job_now() + CAST(o.data->>'startAfter' AS interval) END
          ELSE job.start_after END) + ((o.data->>'retentionSeconds')::int * interval '1s')
            WHEN (o.data -> 'startAfter') IS NOT NULL
              THEN (
        CASE WHEN (o.data -> 'startAfter') IS NOT NULL
          THEN CASE WHEN (right(o.data->>'startAfter', 1) = 'Z' OR o.data->>'startAfter' ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}')
                 THEN (o.data->>'startAfter')::timestamptz
                 ELSE jobs.job_now() + CAST(o.data->>'startAfter' AS interval) END
          ELSE job.start_after END) + (job.keep_until - job.start_after)
            ELSE job.keep_until END,
          expire_seconds = COALESCE((o.data->>'expireInSeconds')::int, job.expire_seconds),
          deletion_seconds = COALESCE((o.data->>'deleteAfterSeconds')::int, job.deletion_seconds),
          retry_limit = COALESCE((o.data->>'retryLimit')::int, job.retry_limit),
          retry_delay = COALESCE((o.data->>'retryDelay')::int, job.retry_delay),
          retry_backoff = COALESCE((o.data->>'retryBackoff')::bool, job.retry_backoff),
          retry_delay_max = CASE WHEN (o.data -> 'retryDelayMax') IS NOT NULL THEN (o.data->>'retryDelayMax')::int ELSE job.retry_delay_max END,
          dead_letter = CASE WHEN (o.data -> 'deadLetter') IS NOT NULL THEN o.data->>'deadLetter' ELSE job.dead_letter END,
          heartbeat_seconds = CASE WHEN (o.data -> 'heartbeatSeconds') IS NOT NULL THEN (o.data->>'heartbeatSeconds')::int ELSE job.heartbeat_seconds END,
          group_id = CASE WHEN (o.data -> 'groupId') IS NOT NULL THEN o.data->>'groupId' ELSE job.group_id END,
          group_tier = CASE WHEN (o.data -> 'groupTier') IS NOT NULL THEN o.data->>'groupTier' ELSE job.group_tier END
      FROM o
      WHERE job.id IN (SELECT id FROM target)
        AND job.state < 'active'
      RETURNING job.id, job.start_after
    )
    SELECT id FROM upd

INSERT INTO jobs.job_common (
      id,
      name,
      data,
      priority,
      start_after,
      created_on,
      singleton_key,
      singleton_on,
      group_id,
      group_tier,
      expire_seconds,
      deletion_seconds,
      keep_until,
      retry_limit,
      retry_delay,
      retry_backoff,
      retry_delay_max,

      dead_letter,
      heartbeat_seconds,
      blocked,
      blocking,
      pending_dependencies,
      trace_context, upsert_by_key
    )
    SELECT
      COALESCE(id, gen_random_uuid()) as id,
      'comments.mention' as name,
      data,
      COALESCE(priority, 0) as priority,
      j.start_after,
      jobs.job_now() as created_on,
      "singletonKey",
      CASE
        
        WHEN "singletonSeconds" IS NOT NULL THEN 'epoch'::timestamp + '1s'::interval * ("singletonSeconds"::float8 * floor(( date_part('epoch', jobs.job_now()) + COALESCE("singletonOffset",0)::float8) / "singletonSeconds"::float8 ))
        ELSE NULL
        END as singleton_on,
      "groupId" as group_id,
      "groupTier" as group_tier,
      COALESCE("expireInSeconds", q.expire_seconds, 900) as expire_seconds,
      COALESCE("deleteAfterSeconds", q.deletion_seconds, 604800) as deletion_seconds,
      j.start_after + (COALESCE("retentionSeconds", q.retention_seconds, 1209600) * interval '1s') as keep_until,
      COALESCE("retryLimit", q.retry_limit, 2) as retry_limit,
      COALESCE("retryDelay", q.retry_delay, 0) as retry_delay,
      COALESCE("retryBackoff", q.retry_backoff, false) as retry_backoff,
      COALESCE("retryDelayMax", q.retry_delay_max) as retry_delay_max,
      q.policy,
      COALESCE("deadLetter", q.dead_letter) as dead_letter,
      COALESCE("heartbeatSeconds", q.heartbeat_seconds) as heartbeat_seconds,
      COALESCE(blocked, false) as blocked,
      COALESCE(blocking, false) as blocking,
      COALESCE("pendingDependencies", 0) as pending_dependencies,
      "__traceContext" as trace_context, true as upsert_by_key
    FROM (
      SELECT *,
        CASE
          WHEN (right("startAfter", 1) = 'Z' OR "startAfter" ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}') THEN CAST("startAfter" as timestamp with time zone)
          ELSE jobs.job_now() + CAST(COALESCE("startAfter",'0') as interval)
          END as start_after
      FROM json_to_recordset($1::text::json) as x (
        id uuid,
        priority integer,
        data jsonb,
        "startAfter" text,
        "retryLimit" integer,
        "retryDelay" integer,
        "retryDelayMax" integer,
        "retryBackoff" boolean,
        "singletonKey" text,
        "singletonSeconds" integer,
        "singletonOffset" integer,
        
        "groupId" text,
        "groupTier" text,
        "expireInSeconds" integer,
        "deleteAfterSeconds" integer,
        "retentionSeconds" integer,
        "deadLetter" text,
        "heartbeatSeconds" integer,
        blocked boolean,
        blocking boolean,
        "pendingDependencies" integer,
        "__traceContext" jsonb
      )
